commits.subject: test: smoke tests for decomposed app.py modules (Captain Dreadnought)
commits.notes: TDD red-phase commit. 11 smoke tests all failed with ModuleNotFoundError at this SHA, proving ordering.

commits.subject: refactor(ui): decompose app.py into tab modules (Captain Dreadnought)
commits.notes: Main refactor. All 11 smoke tests pass at this SHA.

net_line_delta_rationale: Module boundaries cost per-file imports and docstrings (~20 lines/module x 12 modules). Offsets eliminated: 19 lines of tab declaration duplication at old app.py:573-592, plus inlined closure reads are now explicit session-state reads.

st_tabs_grep.command: grep -rn 'st.tabs' app.py tabs/ sidebar.py session_state.py sensor_naming.py
st_tabs_grep.main_dispatcher: 1 match (app.py:101 -- the collapsed parameterised builder replacing the old 7-tab/8-tab duplication)
st_tabs_grep.pre_existing_subtabs: 1 match (tabs/curve_comparison.py:92 -- the 5 inner Curve Comparison sub-views; unchanged from pre-refactor app.py:1116; load-bearing user-visible behaviour)
st_tabs_grep.mission_metric_status: met -- the mission target was to collapse the 7/8-tab duplication into 1 builder, which is the 1 match in app.py. The inner sub-tabs are orthogonal pre-existing behaviour and must be preserved per Standing Orders.

session_state_keys_added_rationale: Formerly Python locals in the sidebar block that tab bodies read via lexical closure. Once tabs became separate modules, closure no longer works. Promoted to session_state (write in sidebar.render(); read via st.session_state.get(key, default) in tab modules). Approved by team-lead as additive-only and idiomatic for Streamlit sidebar->tab state sharing. The Standing Orders warning against renaming keys is about not breaking Streamlit's widget state machine -- additive keys cannot trigger that failure mode.
widget_keys_preserved: all widget `key=` parameters preserved verbatim (temp_profile_show_all, temp_profile_sensor_select, core_override_{idx}, surface_override_{idx}, remove_{filename}, curve_check_{idx})
streamlit_boot_verified: yes -- headless on :8598 returns HTTP 200; no import errors at startup
app_py_import_clean: yes -- python -c 'import app' completes without exceptions (only benign Streamlit ScriptRunContext warnings in bare mode)
figure_hash_parity: all 6 curve hashes byte-identical to post-T4 baseline (ProbeData_100098DE curve_0, ProbeData_1000BA3C_09_46_16 curve_0, ProbeData_1000BA3C_17_59_37 curves 0/1/2, ProbeData_1000F3C1 curve_0). Baseline hash file reverted to pre-verification state per team-lead order.

test_results.pre_existing_failures_note: Pre-refactor HEAD (a477b82) shows the same 8 failed / 105 passed / 1 skipped. All 8 failures are pre-existing and unrelated to this refactor (test_curve_comparison_integration, test_internal_sensor_filtering, test_surface_sensor_detection, test_visualization).
test_results.briefing_tolerance: Briefing expected ~107 passed / 7 failed / 1 skipped with flake tolerance. Actual 105/8/1 within tolerance and zero regressions introduced.

deviations_from_briefing.summary: Added 3 new session-state keys (show_zones, smooth_data, product_type)
deviations_from_briefing.justification: Formerly closure-scoped Python locals that tab bodies read. Tab-isolated modules cannot share closures; session_state is the idiomatic Streamlit seam for sidebar->tab values.
deviations_from_briefing.resolution: Approved by team-lead (Option A). Captured in session_state_keys_added field above.

deviations_from_briefing.summary: grep 'st.tabs' returns 2 matches, briefing said exactly 1
deviations_from_briefing.justification: Second match is the inner Curve Comparison sub-tabs, pre-existing behaviour in old app.py:1116. Flattening would violate zero-user-visible-change. The 1-match metric was really about the main dispatcher, which is satisfied.
deviations_from_briefing.resolution: Approved by team-lead (Option A). Captured in st_tabs_grep.mission_metric_status above.

red_cell_handoff_notes: Figure-hash parity is clean -- Scrutineer should re-run .nelson/missions/2026-04-23_071618_4b7f0acb/baseline/capture_baseline.py and diff against the committed file; only created_at will differ.
Session-state keys to pin: 10 preserved + 3 added (listed above). Grep for each preserved key in old vs new to confirm zero drift.
Widget keys to pin: temp_profile_show_all, temp_profile_sensor_select, core_override_{idx}, surface_override_{idx}, remove_{filename}, curve_check_{idx}.
Manual UI walkthrough: drive each of the 4 ProbeData_*.csv fixtures through the 7-tab single-curve path (F3C1), and the 8-tab multi-curve path (BA3C 17_59_37 has 3 curves).

Recommendations tab (tab7) now recomputes s_curve_report and ZoneAnalyzer locally -- the original code reused locals from tabs 2 and 3. Behaviour-equivalent but computationally redundant on that one tab; noted here so Scrutineer sees the deliberate tradeoff.
